sourceBrief: Correct the founder-rejected crane-shaped object. Establish a clearly recognisable traditional folded paper boat before any further motion production. Its fragile, ordinary material will carry the impossible ocean story.
prompt: Photographic close view of ONE traditional handmade origami paper boat, the instantly recognizable child folded-paper boat shape: a long broad open faceted hull with pointed bow and pointed stern, raised folded triangular walls along both sides, a LOW central triangular folded peak. Matte ivory paper, clean crisp folds, visible paper fibres. It is a BOAT with an open hollow hull, not an origami crane or bird. The entire boat is visible with comfortable space around it, no cropped bow or stern. The boat rests on a dark worn wooden workbench beside a single blank sheet of paper. Warm practical sidelight, rich petrol blue shadows, low camera at hull height, shallow depth of field, natural imperfect tabletop texture, tactile realism, cinematic 35mm lens. No water, no magical effects, no lettering.
